title: My low-poly asset pipeline takes about 50 minutes per model. But spits out almost perfect models.
author: randomforest99
selftext:
These are for Liliput, a Banished-inspired game set in a world of tiny people, found-object buildings and garden creatures.

I approve or reject the designs and give notes. Once a design is approved, the agents handle the modelling, texturing and checks. About 50 minutes per asset at the moment. Claude is doing the pipeline work, with image generation used for designs and texture paintovers. The models have to fit the game’s budgets. The beetle in the video is 876 triangles with four animation clips.

This is somewhere past iteration 20 of the pipeline itself. Feedback gets turned into instructions and checks for later builds. It still gets things wrong, but I’m spending more time on art direction and less on catching the same mistakes again.
